author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Keep GPS freshness time advancing through device sleep
details: Replace awake-only uptime in Core Location with a ContinuousClock reader and preserve original fix age/recovery barriers. Add simulated sleep, expiry and real UTC-step regressions plus source-hashed evidence. Host dependency pin will select this reviewed fix; GPS protocol/receiver and device acceptance remain outstanding.
validation: 20 portable Swift XCTest cases passed using Swift 6.0.3 with complete strict concurrency and warnings as errors in local network-disabled Docker. Core Location/UIKit code excluded on Linux; no Apple SDK/device verification claimed. Checked publisher runs repository structure/shared tests/generated log/whitespace checks.
